Definition: of Chaldee origin (compare H1004 and H6291); fig-house; Beth-phage, a place in Palestine:--Bethphage.
BiblicalUsage: The name Bethphage appears in the New Testament. It turns up in Matthew 21:1, Mark 11:1 and Luke 19:29.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bethphage is a real place God named, part of the land He gave His people.
